leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a custom Angular hook that manages polling logic
Configure polling intervals and control start/stop behavior
Initialize reactive state to track polling data and status
Integrate the polling hook with a component to fetch live data
Manipulate polling parameters dynamically based on user input
Render real-time updates from the polling hook in the UI
Bind error handling and loading states to the polling lifecycle
